actor_lod_scope.exception: The existing 04A decorative quartz drake uses detail 1.
actor_lod_scope.runtime_difference: Staff and ordinary wildlife use ambient detail 1 on Medium/High/Ultra and 0 on Low; glass mites always use 0. Quartz Drake GreatBeast uses 2 on High/Ultra. Inspection meshes therefore exceed several runtime ambient LODs.
